climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A San Joaquin Valley AVA across Madera and part of Fresno counties, with 31,179 acres of wine grapes. It produces 10% of all wine grapes grown in California.
